card.name: Biochemistry terms in pharmacokinetic phrases
card.fires_on: Nouns and word endings in enzyme and drug-level phrases, such as 'enzyme', 'plasma concentrations', 'of' after concentrations, and endings of words like microtubules or reactivity.

modes.label: Enzyme and plasma terms
modes.description: Words like enzyme, plasma or concentrations (and 'of' after them) in metabolism and interaction text.
modes.example: Cytochrome P450 1A2 (CYP1A2) is known to be the major<< enzyme>> involved in the metabolism of caffeine.

modes.label: Ends of long science words
modes.description: Final pieces of long technical words such as microtubules, reactivity, cross-reactivity or isoform.

card.plain: It fires on enzyme and blood-level wording in drug metabolism and interaction passages, and on the ends of long science words.
